sources.label: Holmes Beach Code §62-56 (golf carts barred from Palm Dr, Gulf Dr, Marina Dr 5300-6600 blocks)

enforcement.note: Holmes Beach §62-56 bars golf carts from Gulf Dr, Palm Dr and Marina Dr 5300-6600; Florida golf-cart mode is designated-only, so those roads are already red for carts. The code doesn't restrict LSVs on them.
